correctness.rationale: Checked original Akhmedov–Akhmedov rectangular Mayer–Vietoris presentation in arXiv:2610.03756 (Sec.5, Lemma 11.2, Question 13.1) and verified product-framing eliminates meridional coupling: H1 ≅ coker A_S ⊕ Z/d, d=gcd(p,q), with A_S=[Q_{p,g}; -Q_{q,h}S] and coker Q_1=Z/p, coker Q_2=Z/q. Natural map coker A_S -> coker Q_1⊕coker Q_2 is well-defined and surjective, so finite H1 order divisible by pq*d. Independently reconstructed supplied symplectic transvection matrices S and original adapted cover Q matrices for the three cases, verified S^T J S=J, and enumerated ALL maximal minors using exact SymPy determinants rather than verifier logs: for (4,4) matrix 8x10: 7 nonzero minors, gcd=16; (3,3) 12x14: 7 nonzero, gcd=9; (6,2) 12x14: 4 nonzero, gcd=12. These equal pq, so the surjection is an isomorphism and direct split yields (Z/4)^3, (Z/3)^3, Z/6⊕(Z/2)^2 with minimal orders 64,27,24. Mapping class group onto Sp gives realizable gluing. The finite certificates establish these three witnesses, not all possible gluings; the symbolic quotient proves universal lower bound within product framing.
